scope: Static passport release gates, 50 projects × 10 categories. Passing these gates does not mean V1 launch is complete. Runtime/browser evidence is separate; source truth, external citation availability, full WCAG conformance, legal compliance and physical-device testing are outside these gates.

openLaunchBlockers.title: Verified publisher identity and contact details
openLaunchBlockers.evidence: src/legal/index.html and src/privacy/index.html explicitly retain owner/controller/contact placeholders.
openLaunchBlockers.completion: Owner supplies accurate publisher identity, postal address and working contact channel, then final copy replaces placeholders. No identity or email is inferred.

openLaunchBlockers.title: Hosting/privacy facts remain unconfirmed
openLaunchBlockers.evidence: src/privacy/index.html explicitly says hosting log retention, transfer details and the operator assessment are not finalized.
openLaunchBlockers.completion: Confirm the actual hosting/account practices and finalize policy text. This audit is a technical/content review, not a legal-compliance determination.

gateDefinitions.identity: Unique catalog identity, published route, one primary heading and readable project name
gateDefinitions.search-and-mobile-metadata: Language, canonical, viewport, nonempty description and title; not a ranking or device-performance claim
gateDefinitions.citation-traceability: Exact cited HTTPS URL appears in published passport; external availability and claim accuracy are not tested
gateDefinitions.reported-context: Published operator, equipment, precision and report-date labels agree with catalog
gateDefinitions.research-limitations: Published uncertainty/permission warning and nonempty catalog evidence status
gateDefinitions.approximate-geography: Finite bounded approximate point with explicit precision; not an independently verified landing location
gateDefinitions.local-navigation: All static local destinations/fragments resolve; IDs are unique
gateDefinitions.assets-and-link-safety: Referenced local assets exist, image alternatives are declared, new-tab links isolate their opener; not a full WCAG audit
gateDefinitions.export-consistency: Original CSV and GeoJSON retain catalog identity, source, reported values and approximate geography
gateDefinitions.core-workflow-entry: Project-specific atlas handoff and shared comparison/export/correction loader; runtime flows verified by separate suites
